LanguageData.CC_GodMurmur_Song_Text: {COUNT} of {HOME} stood round the {WATER} at dusk and sang down into it.
LanguageData.CC_GodMurmur_Book_Song: {COUNT} of us stood round the {WATER} at dusk and sang down into it, for the rain.
LanguageData.CC_GodMurmur_Rain_Text: The rain came after {HOME} sang at the water, soft at first and then steady, and a deep croak came up out of the water under it.
LanguageData.CC_GodMurmur_Saw_Rain: {WHO} heard the rain come after the singing at {HOME}, and a deep croak out of the water under it.
LanguageData.CC_GodMurmur_GiveBack_Text: When the water went down, {PAWN} found things left on the mud at its edge: {WHAT}. Nobody here lost them.
LanguageData.CC_GodMurmur_Saw_GiveBack: {WHO} found {WHAT} on the mud at the water's edge at {HOME} when the water went down.
LanguageData.CC_GodMurmur_Frogs_Text: The rain came at last, and with it the frogs, dozens of them, up out of the wet ground all over {HOME}, croaking all night.
LanguageData.CC_GodMurmur_Frogs_TextHeard: The rain came at last, and with it a croaking of frogs from every puddle in {HOME}, though nobody could see a single one.
LanguageData.CC_GodMurmur_Saw_Frogs: {WHO} saw frogs come up out of the wet ground all over {HOME} the night the rain came back.
LanguageData.CC_GodMurmur_Saw_FrogsHeard: {WHO} heard frogs croaking all over {HOME} the night the rain came back, and saw none.
